page_label: 说　明　书 7/17 页

paragraphs.zh: 得到的2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钠盐(97.8％，0.1mol)分八次加入反应瓶中，总加料时间为2h，加毕保温反应5h。反应完毕，负压脱溶，釜残加水120mL，搅拌溶解后滴加浓盐酸将体系pH值酸化至2，之后经过滤、水淋洗、烘干得到产物33.3g，HPLC定量得目标化合物2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸含量为96.7％，以2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯计两步反应收率92.4％。
paragraphs.en: The 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid sodium salt so obtained (97.8%, 0.1 mol) was added to the reaction flask in eight portions, the total addition time being 2 h; after addition was complete the reaction was held at temperature for 5 h. When the reaction was complete the solvent was removed under reduced pressure, 120 mL of water was added to the kettle residue, and after stirring to dissolve, concentrated hydrochloric acid was added dropwise to acidify the system to pH 2. After filtration, water rinsing and drying, 33.3 g of product was obtained; HPLC assay gave a content of the target compound 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid of 96.7%, a two-step yield of 92.4% based on methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate.
paragraphs.notes: Unnumbered continuation of a paragraph that begins on the previous page; no [00NN] marker is printed at the top of this page. The Chinese writes the trifluoroethoxymethyl group as 3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基, i.e. the bracket closes before 甲基, so read literally it is 3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl].

paragraphs.zh: (1)2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐的制备，主要反应过程可以以如下反应方程式表示：
paragraphs.en: (1) Preparation of the 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate salt; the main reaction process can be represented by the following reaction equation:
paragraphs.notes: 苯甲酸盐 is written without naming the cation, so the text does not say which salt at this point.

paragraphs.zh: 向反应瓶中加入叔丁醇70mL，开动搅拌，室温下将14g氢氧化钠(30％，0.105mol)滴入其中，待氢氧化钠分散均匀后，控制釜温在30℃，将34.8g  2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯(98％，0.1mol)倒入釜中进行碱解反应，反应过程微微放热，控制釜温为30℃，反应12h。反应结束，液相色谱中控2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钠盐归一含量为92.5％，负压脱尽溶剂直接用于后续醚化反应。
paragraphs.en: 70 mL of tert-butanol was added to the reaction flask and stirring was started; at room temperature 14 g of sodium hydroxide (30%, 0.105 mol) was added dropwise. Once the sodium hydroxide was uniformly dispersed, the kettle temperature was controlled at 30 degrees C and 34.8 g of methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate (98%, 0.1 mol) was poured into the kettle to carry out the alkaline hydrolysis; the reaction was slightly exothermic, the kettle temperature was controlled at 30 degrees C, and the reaction ran for 12 h. At the end of the reaction, in-process HPLC control gave a normalised content of 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid sodium salt of 92.5%; the solvent was stripped completely under reduced pressure and the material was used directly in the subsequent etherification.
paragraphs.notes: The double space printed between 34.8g and 2-氯 is preserved as printed.

paragraphs.zh: (2)2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的制备，主要反应过程可以以如下反应方程式表示：
paragraphs.en: (2) Preparation of 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid; the main reaction process can be represented by the following reaction equation:

paragraphs.zh: 向反应釜中加入160mLDMF、11.6g三氟乙醇(99％，0.115mol)和17.3g氢氧化钠溶液(30％，0.13mol)，开动搅拌，控制釜温在5℃，将步骤(1)制备得到的2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钠盐(92.5％，0.1mol)分八次加入反应瓶中，总加料时间为2h，加毕保温反应4h。反应完毕，负压脱溶，釜残加水120mL，搅拌溶解后滴加浓盐酸将体系pH值酸化至3，之后经过滤、水淋洗、烘干得到产物30.7g，HPLC定量得目标化合物2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸含量为95.8％，以2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯计两步反应收率84.4％。
paragraphs.en: 160 mL of DMF, 11.6 g of trifluoroethanol (99%, 0.115 mol) and 17.3 g of sodium hydroxide solution (30%, 0.13 mol) were added to the reaction kettle and stirring was started; the kettle temperature was controlled at 5 degrees C and the 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid sodium salt prepared in step (1) (92.5%, 0.1 mol) was added to the reaction flask in eight portions, the total addition time being 2 h; after addition was complete the reaction was held at temperature for 4 h. When the reaction was complete the solvent was removed under reduced pressure, 120 mL of water was added to the kettle residue, and after stirring to dissolve, concentrated hydrochloric acid was added dropwise to acidify the system to pH 3. After filtration, water rinsing and drying, 30.7 g of product was obtained; HPLC assay gave a content of the target compound 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid of 95.8%, a two-step yield of 84.4% based on methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate.
paragraphs.notes: 160mLDMF is printed with no space between the volume and the solvent name.

drawings.notes: Printed with the paragraph marker [0082] in the left margin. The sodium carboxylate is drawn as a covalent Na-O bond, written NaO; the SMILES records it as the ionic salt. Nothing is written below the arrow. Ring numbering is assigned from the carboxyl carbon as C1, which is how the drawing is laid out and how the prose names the compound.

Printed with the paragraph marker [0085] in the left margin. The two reagents above the arrow are printed on one line separated by the full-width enumeration comma: CF3CH2OH、NaOH. The cation on the left-hand structure is drawn as KO, potassium, and this is legible without doubt at high magnification; see discrepancies. The right-hand side chain is drawn skeletally as ring-CH2-O-CH2-CF3, with CF3 as a text label.

Printed with the paragraph marker [0089] in the left margin, the last item on the page; the prose describing this step of Example 4 continues on the following page. Drawn identically to the [0082] scheme, including the covalent NaO on the product.

discrepancies.what: The starting material of the Example 3 etherification is drawn as the potassium salt but described in the prose as the sodium salt.
discrepancies.drawing_says: Left-hand structure of the [0085] scheme carries KO on the carboxyl, i.e. the potassium carboxylate.
discrepancies.text_says: [0086] uses 2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钠盐, the sodium salt prepared in step (1), and step (1) at [0083] uses sodium hydroxide and reports the sodium salt as its product; the [0082] scheme likewise draws NaO.

discrepancies.what: The tert-butanol solvent of the salt-forming step is written but not drawn.
discrepancies.drawing_says: The [0082] and [0089] arrows carry only NaOH above them, with nothing below.
discrepancies.text_says: [0083] specifies 叔丁醇70mL as the reaction medium.

discrepancies.what: The DMF solvent of the etherification is written but not drawn.
discrepancies.drawing_says: The [0085] arrow carries only CF3CH2OH、NaOH above and HCl below.

discrepancies.what: The HCl below the [0085] arrow is not a reagent of the etherification but of the workup, which the drawing does not distinguish.
discrepancies.drawing_says: HCl appears below the single arrow, in the same position a co-reagent would occupy.
discrepancies.text_says: [0086] uses 浓盐酸 only after solvent removal, to acidify the aqueous kettle residue to pH 3 before filtration.
